all_other_variables: Absent by construction: subprocess.run receives only exact environment template plus lock owner. No diagnostic output is read when selecting environment.
cache_identity: Every compiler command has explicit -module-cache-path under a fresh discovery cell. TMPDIR is the fresh reserved output tmp directory. HOME is preserved, never reassigned to a fresh root.
campaign10_effective_values: Not archived; effective-environment hash exists for ARMv6 A4 only, so original value parity cannot be proven or reconstructed.
effective_hash: SHA256 of canonical complete environment including runtime lock owner; sealed before launch and recorded in audit/result/stage
future_policy_boundary: Observed forms apply only to this exact profile/control/source/compiler/SDK/argv/environment context. A future policy/campaign must separately prove applicability to its reviewed environment or explicitly adopt this reviewed discovery context. Raw observation creates no opt-in or dialect allowance.

runtime_addition.GIFTUI_VALIDATION_LOCK_OWNER: actual direct parent PID, held permanent validation lock

subtools: Fixed PATH /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin and DEVELOPER_DIR; compiler executable is absolute and compiler usr tree inventories driver/frontend/Clang/lld/runtime/Embedded modules. Xcode linker, xcrun shim, Xcode Info/version plist are separately hashed. No SDK auto-discovery invocation. Explicit -sdk path and resolved full SDK inventory are sealed.
